projects_page.philosophy_body: I believe great software disappears into the experience. Every line should serve clarity, efficiency, and a Swiss-inspired sense of restraint — form following function without sacrificing beauty.

journey_page.intro: A chronicle of formal computer science foundations, systems research, and industry-validated certifications that cultivate my architectural intuition.
journey_page.education_section_subtitle: Theoretical rigor, algorithmic foundations, and distributed computing architectures from world-class research institutions.
journey_page.certificates_section_subtitle: Professional cloud architect accreditations, container orchestration mastery, and specialized credentials.
journey_page.philosophy_body: Frameworks and libraries fluctuate, but the foundational laws of computer science—distributed consensus, algorithmic bounds, memory cache locality, and clean concurrency—remain unyielding. My education informs every architecture I build.
journey_page.pillar1_desc: Formally reasoning about state invariants, concurrency safety, and system correctness.
journey_page.pillar2_desc: Benchmarking under real saturation, observing tail latencies, and profiling resource bottlenecks.
journey_page.pillar3_desc: Restraint, reliability, and precision engineered into every layer of software.
